title: Argo-Bench: Evaluating Data Agents on Enterprise-Scale Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2610.02122v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-world enterprise data science and analytics workflows require reasoning across dozens of tables, performing statistical analyses, and acting on the results. Established text-to-SQL benchmarks evaluate query generation alone, and audits have found their answer keys frequently wrong. Because real enterprise warehouses are too sensitive to release, these benchmarks are built on public datasets where a business event fits in a single table. We introduce Argo-Bench, an evaluation framework comprising 210 data science and analytics tasks. Drawing on public data, peer-reviewed industry literature, and regulatory filings, we simulate a food delivery platform in New York City at true scale, with 81 million orders in 2024, grounded economics, fraud patterns, and marketplace incentives. translated_title: Argo-Bench：面向企业级工作流的数据智能体评估基准
translated_abstract: 现实世界的企业数据科学与分析工作流需要在数十张表之间进行推理、执行统计分析并基于结果采取行动。现有的文本到SQL（text-to-SQL）基准仅评估查询生成，且经审计发现其标准答案经常出错。由于真实的企业数据仓库过于敏感而无法公开，这些基准只能构建在公开数据集之上，其中单个业务事件可以容纳在一张表中。我们提出了Argo-Bench，一个包含210个数据科学与分析任务的评估框架。基于公开数据、经同行评审的行业文献和监管申报文件，我们模拟了一个纽约市食品外卖配送平台的真实规模，2024年拥有8100万订单，并具有扎实的经济学基础、欺诈模式和市场激励机制。我们将这个模拟世界导出为一个以Oracle E-Business Suite模式为蓝本的ERP数据仓库，包含235张表和75亿行数据。模拟器的真值统计…
tldr: 提出了Argo-Bench——一个包含210个数据科学与分析任务的企业级数据智能体评估基准，通过模拟真实的纽约食品外卖平台并构建包含235张表、75亿行数据的ERP数据仓库，克服了现有text-to-SQL基准仅评估查询生成、标准答案常有错误且数据规模过小的局限。
en_tdlr: Argo-Bench is a benchmark of 210 data science and analytics tasks built on a simulated NYC food delivery platform exported to an ERP warehouse with 235 tables and 7.5 billion rows, overcoming the limitations of existing text-to-SQL benchmarks that only evaluate query generation, frequently contain wrong answer keys, and operate at an unrealistically small scale.
